summary.zh: 杨坚接受北周禅让，建立隋朝。
summary.en: Yang Jian accepted the Northern Zhou abdication and founded the Sui.

description.zh: 581 年，北周外戚杨坚接受静帝禅让，建立隋朝，改元开皇，仍都长安。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 581, Yang Jian, a relative of the Northern Zhou imperial family, accepted Emperor Jing’s abdication, founded the Sui, and kept Chang’an as the capital. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 隋军攻入建康，陈朝灭亡，南北统一。
summary.en: Sui forces entered Jiankang, ending the Chen dynasty and reunifying north and south.

description.zh: 589 年，隋军分路南下，攻入建康，陈后主被俘，陈朝灭亡，结束自西晋末年以来近三百年的分裂。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 589, Sui forces advanced south along several routes and entered Jiankang. Emperor Houzhu of Chen was captured, ending the Chen dynasty and nearly three centuries of division since the fall of Western Jin. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opens the Tongji Canal

summary.zh: 隋炀帝开凿通济渠，连接洛阳与淮河。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opened the Tongji Canal, linking Luoyang with the Huai River.

description.zh: 605 年，隋炀帝下令开凿通济渠，自洛阳引谷、洛水入黄河，再引黄河水入淮河，成为隋唐大运河的核心河段。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 605, Emperor Yang of Sui ordered the Tongji Canal to be dug, linking Luoyang with the Yellow River and then the Huai River. It became a core section of the Sui-Tang Grand Canal. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 隋炀帝征高句丽，围攻辽东城不克。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui campaigned against Goguryeo but failed to take Liaodong.

description.zh: 612 年，隋炀帝亲征高句丽，隋军渡辽水围攻辽东城，久攻不下，此后接连失利，成为隋末动乱的导火索之一。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 612, Emperor Yang of Sui personally campaigned against Goguryeo. Sui forces crossed the Liao River and besieged Liaodong but failed to take it, and later defeats contributed to the unrest that ended the Sui. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Li Yuan proclaimed himself emperor at Chang’an and founded the Tang.

description.zh: 618 年，李渊在长安称帝，建立唐朝，改元武德，随后逐步平定各地割据势力。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 618, Li Yuan proclaimed himself emperor at Chang’an, founded the Tang, and adopted the Wude era name. He then gradually subdued regional rivals. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Li Shimin defeated Dou Jiande at Hulao Pass, laying the basis for unification.

description.zh: 621 年，李世民率军围洛阳，窦建德率军来援，李世民抢占虎牢关，击败窦建德并俘之，洛阳王世充随后投降。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 621, Li Shimin besieged Luoyang. Dou Jiande marched to relieve it, but Li Shimin seized Hulao Pass, defeated and captured Dou, and Wang Shichong at Luoyang then surrendered. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 李世民在玄武门发动政变，随后即位。
summary.en: Li Shimin launched a coup at Xuanwu Gate and soon became emperor.

description.zh: 626 年，秦王李世民在长安玄武门伏杀太子李建成、齐王李元吉，迫使唐高祖立其为太子，不久即位，是为唐太宗。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 626, Li Shimin ambushed and killed Crown Prince Li Jiancheng and Prince Li Yuanji at Xuanwu Gate in Chang’an, forced Emperor Gaozu to name him crown prince, and soon ascended the throne as Emperor Taizong. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Emperor Taizong’s conscientious rule produced the orderly and prosperous Zhenguan era.

description.zh: 627 年起，唐太宗重用魏徵、房玄龄等，轻徭薄赋、完善制度，史称贞观之治。年份为通行说法，具体起讫待史料校订。
description.en: From 627, Emperor Taizong relied on ministers such as Wei Zheng and Fang Xuanling, lightened taxes, and improved institutions, an era later called the Zhenguan governance. Dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: The Tang destroy the Eastern Turks

summary.zh: 唐军击败东突厥，颉利可汗被俘。
summary.en: Tang forces defeated the Eastern Turks and captured Illig Qaghan.

description.zh: 630 年，李靖率唐军出阴山，突袭东突厥牙帐，颉利可汗败走被俘，东突厥灭亡。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 630, Li Jing led Tang forces across the Yin Mountains and attacked the Eastern Turkic camp. Illig Qaghan fled and was captured, ending the Eastern Turkic Khaganate. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Princess Wencheng married Songtsen Gampo of Tubo.

description.zh: 641 年，唐太宗以文成公主嫁吐蕃赞普松赞干布，公主经青海入藏，促进唐蕃和亲与文化交流。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 641, Emperor Taizong sent Princess Wencheng to marry Songtsen Gampo of Tubo. She traveled through Qinghai to Lhasa, promoting peace and cultural exchange between Tang and Tubo. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Tang defeat the Western Turks

summary.zh: 苏定方率唐军击败西突厥，唐朝控制西域。
summary.en: Su Dingfang defeated the Western Turks, extending Tang control over the Western Regions.

description.zh: 657 年，唐将苏定方率军进攻西突厥，在伊犁河流域击败阿史那贺鲁，西突厥汗国灭亡，唐朝随后设都护府管理西域。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 657, the Tang general Su Dingfang campaigned against the Western Turks, defeated Ashina Helu in the Ili region, and ended the Western Turkic Khaganate. Tang subsequently established protectorates in the Western Regions. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Tang and Silla forces defeated the Yamato and Baekje fleet at Baekgang.

description.zh: 663 年，唐与新罗联军在白江口与倭国、百济联军水战，唐军水师以少胜多，焚毁大量敌船，百济复国运动失败。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 663, a Tang–Silla fleet fought the Yamato and Baekje forces at Baekgang. The Tang squadron, though outnumbered, destroyed many enemy ships, ending the Baekje restoration movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor, changed the dynasty to Zhou, and became China’s only female sovereign.

description.zh: 690 年，武则天在洛阳称帝，改国号为周，史称武周，成为中国历史上唯一正统女皇帝。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 690, Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor at Luoyang and changed the dynastic name to Zhou, becoming the only woman to rule China as sovereign in the orthodox line. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Zhang Jianzhi and others forced Wu Zetian to abdicate and restored Emperor Zhongzong.

description.zh: 705 年，张柬之、桓彦范等联合禁军发动神龙政变，逼武则天退位，唐中宗复位，恢复唐朝国号。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 705, Zhang Jianzhi, Huan Yanfan, and others, with palace guard support, launched the Shenlong coup, forced Wu Zetian to abdicate, and restored Emperor Zhongzong and the Tang dynastic name. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 唐玄宗开元年间政局稳定、经济繁荣。
summary.en: The Kaiyuan era of Emperor Xuanzong saw stable government and economic prosperity.

description.zh: 713 年起，唐玄宗任用姚崇、宋璟等，整顿吏治、发展生产，唐朝进入开元盛世，成为当时世界最强盛的国家之一。年份为通行说法，具体起讫待史料校订。
description.en: From 713, Emperor Xuanzong appointed able ministers such as Yao Chong and Song Jing, reformed administration, and promoted production, ushering in the Kaiyuan prosperity that made Tang one of the strongest states of its time. Dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: Tang forces fought the Abbasid army at Talas and were defeated.

description.zh: 751 年，高仙芝率唐军与阿拔斯王朝及葛逻禄联军在怛罗斯交战，因葛逻禄倒戈，唐军大败。此战常被与造纸术西传联系起来，具体细节待史料校订。
description.en: In 751, Gao Xianzhi’s Tang army fought an Abbasid and Karluk coalition at Talas. The Karluks switched sides, and the Tang force was routed. The battle is often linked to the westward transmission of papermaking; details await historical review.

summary.en: An Lushan rose at Fanyang and marched south against the Tang.

description.zh: 755 年，平卢、范阳、河东三镇节度使安禄山以讨杨国忠为名在范阳起兵，率军南下，安史之乱爆发。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 755, An Lushan, military governor of three northern garrisons, rose at Fanyang in the name of removing Yang Guozhong and marched south, beginning the An–Shi Rebellion. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The imperial guards mutinied at Mawei Post as Emperor Xuanzong fled west.

description.zh: 756 年，安禄山军攻破潼关，唐玄宗西逃，禁军在马嵬驿哗变，杀杨国忠，逼死杨贵妃，玄宗随后入蜀。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 756, An Lushan’s forces broke through Tong Pass. Emperor Xuanzong fled west, and the imperial guards mutinied at Mawei Post, killing Yang Guozhong and forcing Yang Guifei’s death before the emperor continued to Sichuan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held Suiyang, blocking the rebels’ southward advance.

description.zh: 757 年，安史叛军围攻睢阳，张巡、许远率军坚守数月，城破殉难，但牵制叛军，保全江淮财赋之地。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 757, An–Shi rebels besieged Suiyang. Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held the city for months before it fell and they died, but their resistance tied down rebel forces and protected the Jiang-Huai revenue region. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 史朝义兵败自杀，安史之乱结束。
summary.en: Shi Chaoyi’s defeat and suicide ended the An–Shi Rebellion.

description.zh: 763 年，史朝义在唐军追击下兵败自杀，安史之乱结束，但河北藩镇割据局面由此形成。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 763, Shi Chaoyi was defeated and took his own life while fleeing Tang forces, ending the An–Shi Rebellion. The aftermath left powerful military governors entrenched in Hebei. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 吐蕃军趁唐西北空虚攻入长安，短暂占据。
summary.en: Tubo forces exploited Tang weakness in the northwest and briefly occupied Chang’an.

description.zh: 763 年，吐蕃军乘唐廷忙于平定安史余部，攻入长安，唐代宗出逃，吐蕃军占据十五日后退出。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 763, while the Tang court was preoccupied with the remnants of the An–Shi Rebellion, Tubo forces entered Chang’an. Emperor Daizong fled, and the Tibetans withdrew after about fifteen days. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 杨炎推行两税法，改革赋税制度。
summary.en: Yang Yan introduced the Two-Tax System, reforming Tang taxation.

description.zh: 780 年，唐德宗采纳杨炎建议，推行两税法，按户等与田亩征税，分夏、秋两季缴纳，改变了以人丁为主的租庸调制。日期与制度为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 780, Emperor Dezong adopted Yang Yan’s proposal and introduced the Two-Tax System, taxing households and land and collecting in summer and autumn, replacing the head-tax-based zu-yong-diao system. Dates and institutions follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 河朔三镇半独立，形成长期藩镇割据。
summary.en: The three Hebei garrisons became semi-independent, entrenching long-term military autonomy.

description.zh: 安史之乱后，魏博、成德、卢龙三镇节度使拥兵自重，781 年前后公开对抗中央，形成河朔藩镇割据局面。年份与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: After the An–Shi Rebellion, the military governors of Weibo, Chengde, and Lulong kept private armies and increasingly defied the court; around 781 they openly resisted central authority, entrenching the Hebei garrison system. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 泾原兵变爆发，朱泚据长安称帝。
summary.en: The Jingyuan troops mutinied, and Zhu Ci seized Chang’an and proclaimed himself emperor.

description.zh: 783 年，泾原镇士兵因赏赐不满在长安哗变，拥立朱泚为帝，唐德宗出逃奉天，唐朝中央权威再受重创。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 783, troops from Jingyuan mutinied in Chang’an over inadequate rewards, backed Zhu Ci as emperor, and forced Emperor Dezong to flee to Fengtian, further damaging central authority. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 唐与吐蕃举行长庆会盟，划定边界。
summary.en: Tang and Tubo concluded the Changqing treaty and fixed their border.

description.zh: 821 年，唐与吐蕃在长安与逻些互遣使者会盟，约定各守边界、互不侵扰，史称长庆会盟，盟碑现存拉萨大昭寺前。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 821, Tang and Tubo exchanged envoys and concluded the Changqing treaty, pledging to respect their border and refrain from attacks. The treaty stele still stands before the Jokhang in Lhasa. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 唐文宗谋诛宦官失败，宦官专权加剧。
summary.en: Emperor Wenzong’s plot against the eunuchs failed, deepening eunuch dominance.

description.zh: 835 年，唐文宗与李训、郑注设计诛杀宦官，事泄失败，宦官大肆屠杀朝臣，史称甘露之变，此后宦官完全控制朝政。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 835, Emperor Wenzong, with Li Xun and Zheng Zhu, plotted to kill the dominant eunuchs. The plot was exposed and failed; the eunuchs massacred officials in what became known as the Ganlu Incident and thereafter dominated the court. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 唐武宗下令拆寺汰僧，佛教受到沉重打击。
summary.en: Emperor Wuzong ordered temples destroyed and monks laicized, dealing a heavy blow to Buddhism.

description.zh: 845 年，唐武宗在道士赵归真等影响下推行灭佛政策，拆毁大量寺院、勒令僧尼还俗，史称会昌灭佛，与北魏太武帝、北周武帝灭佛并称。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 845, influenced by Daoist advisers such as Zhao Guizhen, Emperor Wuzong persecuted Buddhism, destroying many temples and forcing monks and nuns to return to lay life. The campaign is grouped with earlier imperial persecutions of Buddhism. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 张议潮起兵收复敦煌，归附唐朝。
summary.en: Zhang Yichao rose, recovered Dunhuang, and submitted to the Tang.

description.zh: 大中二年（848）沙州豪族张议潮趁吐蕃内乱起兵，逐吐蕃守将，收复沙州，同年东进收复瓜州，随即遣使分十道绕行沙漠赴长安报捷，其中悟真一支经天德军于大中四年（850）抵达。此后又收复伊、肃、甘等州，大中五年（851）遣兄张议潭献十一州图籍，唐置归义军，以张议潮为节度使。
description.en: In 848 Zhang Yichao, a wealthy Shazhou family head, rose amid Tibetan disorder, expelled the Tibetan commander and recovered Shazhou; that year he moved east and took Guazhou, then sent ten groups of envoys across the deserts to Chang’an, of which Wuzhen’s party reached the court via Tiande in 850. Further prefectures followed, and in 851 his brother Zhang Yitan presented the registers of eleven prefectures; the Tang established the Guiyi Army with Zhang Yichao as its commissioner.

summary.zh: 桂州戍卒在庞勋率领下起义，北上攻占徐州。
summary.en: Pang Xun led mutinous garrison troops from Guizhou northward and captured Xuzhou.

description.zh: 咸通四年（863）唐廷为援安南在徐泗募兵二千，分八百人戍守桂州，约定三年一换。至咸通九年（868）已戍六年，徐泗观察使崔彦曾以军帑空虚为由请再留一年，戍卒愤怒。七月，牙官许佶、赵可立等杀都将王仲甫，推粮料判官庞勋为首，劫库兵北还，所过剽掠，州县莫能御，成为唐末大规模民变的前奏。
description.en: In 863 the court raised 2,000 men in Xu and Si for Annam and stationed 800 at Guizhou on a three-year rotation. By 868 they had served six years and governor Cui Yanzeng, pleading empty coffers, asked for one more; the garrison mutinied. In the seventh month officers Xu Ji and Zhao Keli killed commander Wang Zhongfu, chose the supply officer Pang Xun as leader, broke into the stores and marched north, plundering as they went while local officials could not stop them — a prelude to the great revolts of the late Tang.

summary.en: Huang Chao rose at Yuanju and campaigned across the country.

description.zh: 875 年，黄巢响应王仙芝起义，在冤句起兵，此后转战黄淮、江南，并于 880 年北上攻入长安。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 875, Huang Chao rose at Yuanju in response to Wang Xianzhi’s rebellion and campaigned through the Yellow-Huai and Jiangnan regions before marching north and taking Chang’an in 880. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Huang Chao’s forces entered Chang’an and established the Qi regime.

description.zh: 880 年，黄巢军攻入长安，唐僖宗逃往成都，黄巢称帝，国号大齐，但未能稳定控制关中。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 880, Huang Chao’s forces entered Chang’an. Emperor Xizong fled to Chengdu, and Huang Chao proclaimed himself emperor of the Qi dynasty, though he failed to secure control of the Guanzhong region. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Zhu Wen deposed Emperor Ai and founded Later Liang, ending the Tang.

description.zh: 907 年，宣武节度使朱温废唐哀帝，自立为帝，建立后梁，唐朝灭亡，中国进入五代十国时期。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 907, Zhu Wen, military governor of Xuanwu, deposed Emperor Ai, proclaimed himself emperor, and founded Later Liang, ending the Tang and beginning the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 隋炀帝开江南河，自京口至余杭八百余里。
summary.en: Emperor Yang opened the Jiangnan canal from Jingkou to Yuhang, over 800 li.

description.zh: 大业六年（610）炀帝下令开江南河，自京口（今镇江）引长江水南至余杭（今杭州）入钱塘江，全长八百余里，宽十余丈，可通龙舟。至此以洛阳为中心、北起涿郡南至余杭的大运河全线贯通。
description.en: In 610 Emperor Yang ordered the Jiangnan canal dug from Jingkou (Zhenjiang) south to Yuhang (Hangzhou) and into the Qiantang, over 800 li long and wide enough for the imperial dragon boats. With this the Grand Canal from Zhuojun in the north to Yuhang in the south, centred on Luoyang, was complete.

name.en: Zhu Tao campaigns against Li Weiyue

summary.zh: 幽州留后朱滔奉诏南下讨成德李惟岳，破之于束鹿。
summary.en: Zhu Tao of Youzhou marched south against Li Weiyue of Chengde and defeated him at Shulu.

description.zh: 建中二年（781）正月成德节度使李宝臣死，其子李惟岳求袭不允，与魏博田悦、淄青李正己连兵拒命。朝廷诏幽州留后朱滔讨李惟岳；朱滔自幽州出兵，军于莫州，与易州张孝忠合兵，十一月在束鹿大破李惟岳，进围深州。次年朝廷割深州与康日知，朱滔求深州不得，遂反，南下救田悦至魏州。
description.en: In the first month of 781 Li Baochen of Chengde died and his son Li Weiyue was refused succession, so he joined Tian Yue and Li Zhengji in revolt. The court ordered Zhu Tao of Youzhou against him; Zhu Tao marched out, camped at Mozhou, joined Zhang Xiaozhong of Yizhou, routed Li Weiyue at Shulu in the eleventh month and besieged Shenzhou. The next year, denied Shenzhou, he turned against the court and marched south to Weizhou to aid Tian Yue.

sources.note: 建中二年朱滔军于莫州、束鹿之战、进围深州

sources.note: 朱滔讨李惟岳与四镇之乱

summary.zh: 张淮深率蕃汉兵七千东征，克复凉州，河陇故地尽复。
summary.en: Zhang Huaishen led 7,000 troops east and took Liangzhou, completing the recovery of Hexi and Longyou.

description.zh: 大中十二年（858）八月，张议潮命侄张淮深率蕃、汉兵七千东征凉州，吐蕃集重兵于姑臧，围攻三年。咸通二年（861）三月克复凉州，表奏朝廷，“河陇陷没百余年，至是悉复故地”。咸通四年（863）唐复置凉州节度使，以张议潮兼领；咸通八年（867）张议潮入朝，侄张淮深留守归义军。
description.en: In the eighth month of 858 Zhang Yichao sent his nephew Zhang Huaishen east with 7,000 Tibetan and Chinese troops against Liangzhou, where the Tibetans concentrated their forces; the siege lasted three years. Liangzhou fell in the third month of 861 and the recovery was reported to the court — “the Hexi and Longyou lands, lost for over a century, were all recovered”. In 863 the Tang restored the Liangzhou command and gave it to Zhang Yichao; in 867 he went to court and Zhang Huaishen took charge of the Guiyi Army.

summary.zh: 庞勋北上攻占宿州、徐州，众至数万，震动江淮。
summary.en: Pang Xun marched north, took Suzhou and Xuzhou and gathered tens of thousands, shaking the Huai region.

description.zh: 咸通九年（868）十月，庞勋自桂州北还的八百戍卒沿途扩至六七千人，十日攻占宿州，十三日击败徐州援军，十七日进抵彭城，城中军民响应，不到一个时辰破城，囚观察使崔彦曾，开府库募兵，旬日聚众五万。此后攻濠、滁、和等州，围泗州，断江淮漕运。十年九月为康承训、朱邪赤心所败，庞勋死于蕲县。
description.en: In the tenth month of 868 Pang Xun’s 800 returning garrison, grown to six or seven thousand, took Suzhou on the tenth, beat the relief force on the thirteenth and reached Pengcheng on the seventeenth; the townspeople rose, the city fell within an hour, governor Cui Yanzeng was imprisoned and the treasury opened, drawing 50,000 men within ten days. He then took Hao, Chu and He prefectures and besieged Sizhou, cutting the Huai grain route. In the ninth month of 869 he was defeated by Kang Chengxun and Zhuye Chixin and died at Qixian.

sources.title: 《资治通鉴》卷二百五十一
